nodes.label: Barrel File (index re-exports)
nodes.rationale: Barrel imports can make all re-exported modules reachable and evaluated, adding bundle size, startup cost, and circular dependencies that break HMR.

nodes.label: Direct Imports Pattern
nodes.rationale: Importing from the specific module path loads only what is used; safer than relying on tree shaking, enforceable with eslint-plugin-no-barrel-files.

nodes.label: Re.Pack ScriptManager and React.lazy chunks
nodes.rationale: Only apply when the app already uses Re.Pack or has an explicit remote-code requirement; Hermes mmap makes splitting marginal.

nodes.label: Remote Chunk Security Model
nodes.rationale: Chunks are executable code: serve from first-party HTTPS, allowlist or signed manifest, strict signature verification, fail closed; untrusted chunk sources equal remote code execution.

nodes.label: Hermes Memory Mapping (mmap)
nodes.rationale: Compressed bundles cannot be memory-mapped; noCompress for bundle trades about 8% larger install for about 16% faster TTI on RN 0.78 and earlier; RN 0.79+ defaults to uncompressed.

nodes.label: Bundlephobia / pkg-size / Import Cost tools
nodes.rationale: These measure JS package cost only; native code from RN libraries must be verified in the real IPA/AAB/APK.

nodes.label: iOS Asset Catalog (RNAssets.xcassets)
nodes.rationale: Android AAB delivers per-density assets automatically; iOS needs --asset-catalog-dest so App Store thinning delivers only the needed resolution (about 40% smaller example).

nodes.label: ProGuard Keep Rules
nodes.rationale: R8 can remove code it thinks is unused; add library-specific keep rules only when a release build breaks, and always QA the release build.

nodes.label: Expo experimentalImportSupport and tree-shaking env flags
nodes.rationale: Metro has no general tree shaking; Expo SDK 52+ offers experimental production-only removal requiring ESM and side-effect-safe modules.

nodes.label: Platform Shaking (Platform.OS)
nodes.rationale: Requires direct import of Platform from react-native; namespace import defeats it.

nodes.label: UI Thread Worklets (scheduleOnUI / scheduleOnRN)
nodes.rationale: Running animations on the UI thread keeps them smooth during heavy JS work; keep worklets fast.

nodes.label: Reanimated 3 to 4 Migration
nodes.rationale: v4 requires New Architecture and react-native-worklets; runOnUI/runOnJS become scheduleOnUI/scheduleOnRN.

nodes.label: Jotai and Zustand selectors
nodes.rationale: Subscribers re-render only for the atom or selector they use, versus broad Context values; migrate only when profiling shows unrelated subscriber renders.

nodes.label: @gorhom/bottom-sheet
nodes.rationale: v5 targets Reanimated v3; use library scrollables and BottomSheetTextInput; true-sheet is a native alternative on Fabric.

nodes.label: animatedIndex / animatedPosition SharedValues
nodes.rationale: Gesture-driven visual state should stay on the UI thread via shared values instead of onAnimate-driven React state, avoiding subtree re-renders.

nodes.label: useDeferredValue
nodes.rationale: Defers an expensive subtree so input stays responsive; works best when the subtree is memoized.

nodes.label: useTransition
nodes.rationale: Marks non-critical state updates as low priority and exposes isPending.

nodes.label: FlashList / FlatList / Legend List
nodes.rationale: Virtualized lists replace ScrollView.map; FlashList v1 needs estimatedItemSize while v2 ignores it, so check the installed major version.

nodes.label: Flashlight and Perf Monitor
nodes.rationale: Measure on real devices in release-like builds; compare UI vs JS thread FPS to locate the bottleneck.

nodes.label: useEffect Cleanup (listeners and timers)
nodes.rationale: Missing cleanup of listeners and timers is the most common React Native leak; use DevTools allocation timeline and compare shallow vs retained size.

nodes.label: agent-device react-devtools profiling
nodes.rationale: Profile the exact flow, inspect slow components and rerender counts before proposing memoization or state changes.

nodes.label: React Compiler
nodes.rationale: Automatic memoization replaces manual memo/useMemo/useCallback when code follows Rules of React; run healthcheck first and adopt incrementally.

nodes.label: Uncontrolled Components
nodes.rationale: Controlled TextInput causes native-JS round trips and flicker on legacy architecture; use defaultValue unless React must mask or validate each keystroke.

nodes.label: zipalign -P 16 verification
nodes.rationale: Google Play requires 16 KB support; RN 0.79+ aligns its own binaries but third-party .so files must be checked in CI and rebuilt if misaligned.

nodes.label: Cold Start Markers (react-native-performance)
nodes.rationale: Only cold, foreground, non-prewarmed starts give consistent TTI; screenInteractive marks true interactivity.

nodes.label: Hunt Native Memory Leaks
nodes.rationale: Use Xcode Instruments Leaks and Android Studio Memory Profiler/LeakCanary for native leaks invisible to the JS profiler.

nodes.label: Smart Pointers, ARC, and Weak References
nodes.rationale: Prefer unique_ptr and stack allocation in C++, weak references to break cycles in Swift/C++, and removable listeners in Kotlin.
